sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text:
A memo detailing the whereabouts of a kodachi short sword known as Sabimaru.
The ancient kodachi Sabimaru can be found within Ashina Castle, enshrined in the bottom floor of the keep.
Sabimaru was wielded in wars of old, and is a national treasure of Ashina.
Supposedly the blade's poisonous blue rust could drive off even the inhuman Okami warrior women.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text:
Provides a clue about Sabimaru (Upgrade Material) that unlocks the Sabimaru Prosthetic Tool after being given to the Sculptor at the Dilapidated Temple.
The upgrade material is found in a chest behind an Isshin's Pupil on the ground floor of Ashina Castle, accessible from the Upper Tower - Antechamber.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Full description can only be read after purchasing the item.
- Carries over to New Game Plus.
